name: web_search
description: Search the web for any information (news, general knowledge, facts). Requires TAVILY_API_KEY.

name: crypto_price
description: Get real-time cryptocurrency prices (bitcoin, ethereum, solana, etc.)

name: weather
description: Get current weather for any location.

name: get_current_date_time
description: Get the current date and time.

name: tv_control
description: Control the Panasonic TV. Commands: channel_up, channel_down, volume_up, volume_down, mute, power, ok, back, home, menu, guide, input, or 'channel' to tune to a specific channel. Known channels: 99=VIUTV (VIU TV, VIU), 77=HOYTV (HOY TV, HOY), 81=TVB, 83=TVB新聞 (TVB News).

name: remember
description: Save important information to long-term memory. Store in English.

name: recall
description: Search long-term memory for relevant information. Search in English.

name: tool_writer_agent
description: A developer pipeline that creates, tests, and deploys new tool files. Delegate when the user wants to add a new capability.

name: get_exchange_rate
description: Get the current exchange rate between two currencies (e.g., USD to HKD).

name: forget
description: Delete a memory from long-term memory. Always confirm with the user before deleting.

name: set_identity
description: Set your own identity (e.g. name). Use when user gives you a name or tells you about yourself.

name: get_identity
description: Get your own identity info (e.g. your name). Use when someone asks who you are.

name: save_person
description: Save a person with relationship (graph) and profile/preferences (semantic search).

name: find_person
description: Find a person by name or relationship in the graph.

name: search_people
description: Semantic search on people profiles (e.g. "who likes hiking?", "someone in tech").

name: update_person
description: Update a person's notes/profile or relationship.

name: remove_person
description: Remove a person. Confirm with user first.
